description: Several chunky plastic blocks in blue, yellow, green, red, and white sit on the dark bedspread in front of a pillow. The right hand moves in from the right to grasp the stacked blocks with the left hand supporting them, then the right hand lifts off the white block and sets it down on the bed; next the right hand pulls away the red block, and both hands continue disassembling by separating the green and yellow pieces, leaving the blue base and placing the loose blocks nearby.
